description: Source code defining classes and functions related to Xcode project object representations, including PBX objects, build phases, targets, and project structure.

classes.name: PBXObject
classes.description: Base class for all PBX project objects, providing identification, commenting, and visitor pattern support.

classes.name: PBXTarget
classes.description: Represents a build target in an Xcode project, including dependencies, build phases, and configurations.

classes.name: PBXProject
classes.description: Represents an entire Xcode project, managing targets, configurations, and project structure.

classes.name: PBXBuildPhase
classes.description: Abstract class for build phases, managing build files and their execution order.

classes.name: XCConfigurationList
classes.description: Holds a list of build configurations for a target or project.

classes.name: XCBuildConfiguration
classes.description: Represents a single build configuration with specific build settings.

classes.name: PBXFileReference
classes.description: Represents a file or resource reference within the project.

classes.name: PBXGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of files or other groups, forming the project hierarchy.

classes.name: PBXNativeTarget
classes.description: A native executable or library target with associated build phases and dependencies.

classes.name: PBXAggregateTarget
classes.description: A group of targets or a target that aggregates other targets.

classes.name: PBXShellScriptBuildPhase
classes.description: Build phase for executing shell scripts.

classes.name: PBXContainerItemProxy
classes.description: Proxy object linking targets and projects.

classes.name: PBXBuildFile
classes.description: Represents a build file reference used in build phases.

methods.name: SetId
methods.description: Assigns a unique identifier to the PBXObject.

methods.name: Reference
methods.description: Returns the reference string for the object, including comment if available.

methods.name: Comment
methods.description: Returns the comment string for the object, typically its name.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Accepts a visitor object to perform operations based on object type.
